boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: Earth Corps, Cyberbot Platoon One. That day, a secret mock battle tested a new machine.

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: But then, something no one expected happened.

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: The new cyberbot suddenly went berserk and began destroying its own side's machines.

boxes.speaker: A platoon pilot
boxes.english: Damn it, wasn't this just a drill!? If only Aichmann were here...!

boxes.speaker: A platoon pilot
boxes.english: Wh-what IS this thing...!! C-Captaaain!!

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: This can't be... All this from a single cyberbot...!!

boxes.speaker: A platoon pilot
boxes.english: Here it comes! ...Waaaahh!!

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: !! Those moves...!

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: It can't be... Aichmann, is that you!? It is, isn't it!?

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: Aichmann...! What have they done to you!?

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: You can't stop yourself, can you!? Hold on! I'll stop you!!

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: Gahh...

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Target destroyed.

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: !! E-Aichmann...!! I'm sorry... I couldn't stop you...

boxes.speaker: An officer
boxes.english: ...What a disaster!! Get the survivors out, now!! The exercise is over!!

boxes.speaker: A scientist
boxes.english: No, SHADE performed beyond expectations... The experiment was a success.

boxes.speaker: An official
boxes.english: Splendid.

boxes.speaker: An official
boxes.english: We'll approve the extra budget you requested. Finish it as soon as you can...

boxes.speaker: Narration
boxes.english: One year later...

boxes.speaker: Announcer
boxes.english: And now, at last, tonight's main event!

boxes.speaker: Announcer
boxes.english: Our 15th champion, 98 straight wins and unbeaten! The Samurai Warrior, Jin Saotome!!

boxes.speaker: Announcer
boxes.english: His opponent, the mystery apostle of darkness, SHADE! Every foe scrapped in 3 seconds!

boxes.speaker: An official
boxes.english: Data collection is going well, I see. ...Tell me, is SHADE conscious at all?

boxes.speaker: A scientist
boxes.english: Of course not. The human brain is just an organic part. It's a weapon, nothing more.

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: ...Saotome...

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Ken Saotome...?

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: What!? How do you know my father's name...!?

boxes.speaker: Announcer
boxes.english: READY...

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Never mind. I'll beat you down first, then ask questions!

boxes.speaker: Announcer
boxes.english: GO!!

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: ...Now I get it...! You're Aichmann... the one who killed my father...!!

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: ...Aichmann?

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Someday I'll beat you! And I'll avenge my father...!

boxes.speaker: A scientist
boxes.english: Don't you talk to SHADE! SHADE, we're pulling out!

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: ...Understood.

boxes.speaker: A scientist
boxes.english: ......Next, we begin collecting real combat data.

boxes.speaker: An official
boxes.english: Good. I expect great things.

boxes.speaker: A lieutenant
boxes.english: So, the Resistance has been smoked out.

boxes.speaker: A soldier
boxes.english: Lieutenant, are we really using THAT?

boxes.speaker: A lieutenant
boxes.english: ...Those are our orders. SHADE, launch.

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Understood.

boxes.speaker: A soldier
boxes.english: ...Damn robot!

boxes.speaker: Santana
boxes.english: Whoa, you gotta be kidding! I'm just an info broker... Like you'd listen. Jeez!

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Target acquired.

boxes.speaker: Santana
boxes.english: Stop! Don't kill meee!! ...Wait, aren't you Aichmann!?

boxes.speaker: Santana
boxes.english: Of all the people to come back and haunt...!! Please, just rest in peace!!

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: ...Aichmann...

boxes.speaker: A lieutenant
boxes.english: Well done, SHADE. Fall back.

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Understood.

boxes.speaker: A lieutenant
boxes.english: "Well done," I said... To a weapon. A robot.

boxes.speaker: A scientist
boxes.english: As you can see, SHADE's results are outstanding.

boxes.speaker: An official
boxes.english: We are well satisfied with the results.

boxes.speaker: An official
boxes.english: Keep the mass-production line on schedule.

boxes.speaker: SHADE (memory: Jin)
boxes.english: You're Aichmann... You killed my father!!
boxes.note: SHADE replays what others said to him.

boxes.speaker: SHADE (memory: Santana)
boxes.english: Aren't you Aichmann!? Of all the people to come back and haunt...!

boxes.speaker: A scientist
boxes.english: Impossible! SHADE is gone!? He can't act on his own!! What on earth...!?

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Data search... "Aichmann"... Searching...

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: !! ..."Deceased"...!!

boxes.speaker: A guard
boxes.english: What are you doing there!? This data bank is off-limits... !! You're...!?

boxes.speaker: A lieutenant
boxes.english: Ugh... SHADE, why...?

boxes.speaker: An officer
boxes.english: !! The Resistance!? What are the patrols doing!!

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: So that's the Earth Corps' secret weapon! Perfect. Let's take it!
boxes.note: Speaker inferred: Chiyomaru's party (Chiyomaru is named in the next scene).

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: ...I... I am not... a "weapon"...!

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: So this is the secret weapon's power...!

boxes.speaker: Tessan
boxes.english: Lord Chiyomaru, we must fall back for now.

boxes.speaker: Chiyomaru
boxes.english: It can't be helped...

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: SHADE... What will you do now?
boxes.note: Speaker uncertain; could be another former comrade.

boxes.speaker: A scientist
boxes.english: No, this is... This should never have happened...!

boxes.speaker: An official
boxes.english: Spare me your excuses. You have disappointed me.

boxes.speaker: A scientist
boxes.english: Please, wait! This must be some kind of...!!

boxes.speaker: Bao
boxes.english: What do we do!? We got dragged into something awful!

boxes.speaker: Mao
boxes.english: Big brother, I'm scared!

boxes.speaker: Bao
boxes.english: It's okay, leave it to your big brother... ? What's that?

boxes.speaker: Mao
boxes.english: It's coming this way!

boxes.speaker: Bao
boxes.english: Damn it, bring it on!!

boxes.speaker: Bao
boxes.english: ...Why aren't you killing us?

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Are you hurt?

boxes.speaker: Bao
boxes.english: ...Who are you? Aren't you a soldier?

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: I am Aichmann. Not a robot... and not a man.

boxes.speaker: Mao
boxes.english: Mister... you look sad.

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: Aichmann!

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Who's there...? Gawaine... Captain Gawaine?

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: So you have your memory back. But the man you seek is not here.

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: He is... Saotome is here. I know it...

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: And when you find him?

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: I fight him. That is why I exist now... Something inside me says so.

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: Then all the more reason I can't let you. If you meet, one of you will surely die.

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: I am a lifeless machine. Death means nothing to me, Captain Gawaine.

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: Aichmann... Then I have no choice.

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: ...So I couldn't stop you after all...

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Farewell, Captain Gawaine. When red blood still ran in my veins, you were my pride.

boxes.speaker: Captain Gawaine
boxes.english: Aichmann... You damned fool...!

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Saotome! Jin Saotome!!

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: !! SHADE... No, Aichmann!!

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: I have come to settle this.

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Yeah, I've been waiting... But it looks like that'll have to wait.

boxes.speaker: SHADE's copy
boxes.english: "Death... destruction..."

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: What's that? ...A copy of you?

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: So it seems... Leave this one to me.

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: You planning to die?

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: I won't die. Not until I settle things with you.

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Good answer. See you later, then!

boxes.speaker: SHADE's copy
boxes.english: ...All things... into chaos...

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Come on, brother!

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Is it over...? Where's Jin?

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: So you came, Aichmann.

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Yes...

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: I told you once I'd beat you.

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: I remember... Machines don't forget. Now I will fight you, with all I have...!

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: ...Here I come!!

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: ...Come!!

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: -- Mission complete --

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Data collection complete. Destroying target.

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: My name is SHADE. The "shadow" of the man I once was.

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Who are you? Why do you torment me?

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Pain, even loneliness, mean nothing to this body now.

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: A body with red blood in its veins... Go now.
Born of Darkness...
Duel
Memory
Awakening
Something at Stake
Heart
The Beginning of the End
Mirror Image
...Back to Darkness

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: ...I lose! Go on, finish me off.

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: I am... not SHADE... Not a weapon made by the Earth Corps...

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: But in the end, I could not become Aichmann again either...

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Fragments of memory remain, but the man called Aichmann is no longer here.

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: I can't even remember Ken Saotome's face anymore...

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Aichmann...

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Then who am I? Not man, not robot. Just short-lived organic parts and machinery...

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: But when I fought you, I could be myself...

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Aichmann!!

boxes.speaker: SHADE
boxes.english: Don't call me that. I am SHADE. ...Remember me, the warrior who fought you...

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Aichmann... SHAAAAADE!!

boxes.speaker: Speaker name
boxes.note: Official US arcade English (slot 610), on the disc since M8; not changed.

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: Say, Gawaine... Should I cry for him?

boxes.speaker: Speaker name
boxes.note: Official US arcade English (slot 614), on the disc since M8; not changed.

boxes.speaker: Gawaine
boxes.english: Do whatever you think is right.

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: ...No, I won't. He... he was a warrior.

boxes.speaker: Jin
boxes.english: He fought to the very end. He was my greatest rival... So long, SHADE!
